remarks: Absolutely charming and beautifully renovated, this unique 2-bedroom, 2-full-bath apartment occupies the second and third floors of a gorgeous property where classic architectural character meets modern-day comfort. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the residence offers the warmth and personality of an older home while delivering the amenities today's renters appreciate. The bright, inviting interior features a beautifully renovated eat-in kitchen with high-end stainless steel appliances and natural gas cooking, along recessed lighting and ceiling fans. Enjoy your own private balcony as well as a shared ground-level outdoor space-creating a wonderful extension of the home for relaxing and enjoying the outdoors. Spread across two levels, this apartment has a sense of privacy and character that is difficult to find in a typical rental. It truly feels like its own private oasis. One off-street assigned parking space is included, with plenty of additional on-street parking available. This is a special property, the kind that only comes along when old-world charm and architecture are thoughtfully blended with modern finishes and conveniences. Take a look at the photos, they truly speak for themselves!
